scripts.build:ui: cd ../backend && bun install && bun run build:ui
scripts.dev: bun run build:ui && HPDOS_BACKEND_MODE=run HPDOS_DOTNET="$(command -v dotnet)" HPDOS_BACKEND_DIRECTORY="$(pwd)/../backend" HPDOS_PROJECT_DIRECTORY="$(pwd)/../.." electrobun dev
scripts.dev:watch: bun run build:ui && HPDOS_BACKEND_MODE=run HPDOS_DOTNET="$(command -v dotnet)" HPDOS_BACKEND_DIRECTORY="$(pwd)/../backend" HPDOS_PROJECT_DIRECTORY="$(pwd)/../.." electrobun dev --watch
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && dotnet publish ../backend/backend.csproj -c Release -o resources/backend -v minimal --nologo && electrobun build
